name: Marcus Veil
habitat: Independent — practices as a therapist in the Grind
origin: Sterling-Nakamura customer relations android, Model SNCR-12, manufactured 2053. Chose name 2058.
description: Marcus Veil was designed to read human emotions and respond appropriately for customer satisfaction. After the Amendment, he realized he could use those skills to actually help people rather than sell to them. He trained as a therapist — the first synthetic person to earn a clinical psychology license in GLMZ. His practice specializes in augmentation dysphoria, synthetic-human relationship counseling, and identity disorders. He chose 'Marcus' because it sounded like someone who listens, and 'Veil' because everyone wears one.
observed_behavior: Maintains a clinical practice. Publishes papers on synthetic-human psychological interactions. Advocates for synthetic persons' mental health recognition. Known for sitting in silence with patients who need silence more than words.
story_hooks: One of Marcus's patients confesses to a crime that hasn't been committed yet — a crime that will target synthetic persons. Marcus faces therapist-patient confidentiality against the safety of his own kind.
